title: The pushforward-pullback composite of a finite locally free morphism is multiplication by the degree
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a finite locally free morphism of degree d the composite of pushforward with pullback is multiplication by d on cycle classes, and that such a morphism is proper and flat of relative dimension zero (statement lines 2438-2450, tag 02R4-adjacent). The proof records properness and flatness, reduces to the class of an integral closed subscheme, observes that the base change over it is again finite locally free of degree d, and computes the cycle class of the pushed forward structure sheaf. The degree computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
